text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho—the Classic Triple<n>Crown race said
to be won only by<n>the strongest Umamusume—is
finally<n>here.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I endorse her skills before trying to<n>send her off to
the race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
However, she responds that the<n>strength of our
bond is more<n>important than her skill.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Intent on proving this, she heads to<n>the racecourse
with an invigorated<n>look, as if freed from the
shackles<n>that once held her back.
